    "mood": "solemn, monumental, hierarchically ordered, ceremonially austere"

    "double-eaved hip-and-gable roof with concave gutter lines",

  ],
  "soft_constraints": [
    "Slight weathering on marble and wood finishes acceptable for realism.",
    "Subtle ambient occlusion in dougong joints and beneath eaves encouraged.",
    "Golden highlights on dougong and beam ends should be physically plausible (not flat overlay)."
  ],
  "uncertainties": [
    "Exact number and arrangement of dougong tiers per bay (sources describe 'ordered' but not count-per-location).",
    "Precise curvature radius of roof concavity (described qualitatively as '凹形曲线').",
    "Color saturation of vermillion lacquer — historical pigment variation not quantified in sources."
